purpose: Independent matrix projection candidate for the frozen fixed unique-weight R graphs; small Q0 only until coordinator schedules more work.

scope.accepted: Fixed, sorted unique (target,source) edges; one scalar bank parameter per edge; fixed beta and threshold; nondelayed projections. Existing nine R cases are representable without fixture changes.
scope.semantics: At every tick all layers drift, apply strict > threshold and subtract detached-reset spikes. Only then are input and same-tick spikes projected to post-reset voltages, so recurrent current changes the next threshold. No layerwise retiming.
scope.training: FP64; CE on 5*mean_T(output spikes); surrogate 1/(1+5*abs(margin))^2; SGD lr .001; Adam lr .001, beta1 .9, beta2 .999, eps 1e-8 outside sqrt; three steps.

cells.spyx: spyx.nn.LIF with drift before beta=1 cell and detached-reset correction
cells.brainx_state: canonical equations inside brainstate.HiddenState and actual transform.scan/grad/jit; not a default BrainPy neuron

scope.matrix_orientation: [target,source], y = matrix @ feed.T; preserve exact bank parameter identity through reshapes or one gather per forward.
scope.auto_storage: Complete projections use dense matmul. Incomplete projections use native Torch COO sparse.mm or JAX BCOO. Choice depends only on frozen topology, never results.
scope.dense_storage: Explicit separate view; all projections use dense matrices, absent edges fixed zero and not optimizer parameters. Not an automatic fallback.
scope.compile: Torch eager is the default new matrix view. Optional fullgraph=True is separate and must independently qualify; rejection cannot trigger eager fallback. JAX variants JIT the derivative and full Adam step.
scope.frozen_R_data: Same count inputs .9/.095/.005, self-inclusive Bernoulli graphs, initial weights and independent SeedSequence streams from recurrent-fixture-r1.json. No new full R fixtures or retuned dimensions.
scope.unqualified_extra_layouts: Generic parameter permutation is implemented but Q0 targets the source-major/target-major bank layouts used by the fixed R fixtures. No arbitrary-layout qualification claim.

memory_and_performance_limits.old_reference_audit: graph_competitor.py gathers B x E feed and multiplies per-edge weights on each tick; autodiff can retain temporal edge intermediates.
memory_and_performance_limits.new_design: Construct each projection matrix once per forward before the time loop/scan. Each tick uses whole-layer dense/sparse matrix multiplication; no explicit adapter-level B x E tensor in the temporal loop.
memory_and_performance_limits.not_proven: Native operator backward, compiler temporaries and memory scaling remain unmeasured. Removing explicit adapter edge intermediates is not proof of O(BTN+E) total peak RSS or capacity superiority.
memory_and_performance_limits.jax_sparse: BCOO is an experimental reference implementation. Official JAX documentation does not recommend it for performance-critical use. This native sparse view is not a strongest optimized JAX baseline claim.
memory_and_performance_limits.diagnostics: run_case returns full state/spike/gradient histories and optimizer diagnostics. It is a qualification entry point, not a public API performance worker.
memory_and_performance_limits.resources: Whole process-tree RSS includes qualification, oracle, serialization and compiler caches. OMP=1 does not restrict the JAX thread pool to one core.

q0.common_arrays: Reuse fixtures/q0.json signed diagnostic inputs and FF weights unchanged. This anchor is distinct from the frozen count-distribution full R workload.
q0.dense: Use graph_fixture(shared=False); reorder only recurrent bank to target-major identity indexing, matching full R p=1. Feedforward banks remain source-major.
q0.sparse: From dense Q0 retain coordinates where (source+2*target)%3 != 0, keep target/source order and compact bank IDs. Self edges follow this same fixed predicate.
q0.initial_variants: Zero initial and the existing strict-threshold boundary/nonzero graph initial array; four cases total.
checks: all parameter gradients and initial-state VJP
local arbitrary-cotangent surrogate VJP for competitors
three complete Adam steps with states, spikes, VJP, all weights, moments and step count
direct same-case Atlas comparison plus independent NumPy graph oracle
q0.oracle: Existing independent atlas_graph_qualification.forward_vjp and independent NumPy Adam; no framework math imported into oracle.

bounded_remote_queue.cleanup: Reuse frozen run_recurrent_queue.launch: retain every observed descendant PID+create_time identity, kill/verify complete owned tree including native sessions, exclude direct Popen child from psutil reaping.
bounded_remote_queue.classification: Timeout phase records engine execution, native prefix replay, diagnostic conversion, independent oracle or artifact saving separately. Guard hit is resource_limit. Software rejection/exit without terminal JSON is not OOM. No failure is a performance score.
bounded_remote_queue.no_overlap: Reject when another evaluation preparation, worker or supervisor is present; only run after coordinator establishes a serial slot.
bounded_remote_queue.no_full_queue: No R225 qualification, no full-size fixture generation, no new performance workload or benchmark entry point.

official_operator_references.fact: COO sparse-dense backward supported for both operands; installed remote version still requires Q0.
BCOO supports transforms but is experimental reference code and is not recommended for performance-critical use.
Sparse BCOO data/index constructor accepts indices_sorted and unique_indices declarations.

execution_status_at_creation: Not executed. Local checks limited to AST/JSON parsing. No model imports, remote upload or compute.
